description_en: Modifies the node specifications of a multi-zone instance by calling ModifyMultiZoneClusterNodeType
description_zh: 通过ModifyMultiZoneClusterNodeType修改多可用区实例的节点规格
kebab_example: aliyun hbase modify-multi-zone-cluster-node-type --cluster-id ld-dj45g7d6rbrd0000 --master-instance-type hbase.sn1.8xlarge --core-instance-type hbase.sn1.large --log-instance-type hbase.sn1.2xlarge --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyMultiZoneClusterNodeType

parameters.help_en: The ID of the multi-zone instance
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The node specifications of the master node. For valid values, refer to DescribeInstanceType
parameters.help_zh: master节点规格，可填种类参考 DescribeInstanceType
parameters.name: master_instance_type

parameters.help_en: The node specifications of the core node. For valid values, refer to DescribeInstanceType
parameters.help_zh: core节点规格，可填种类参考 DescribeInstanceType
parameters.name: core_instance_type

parameters.help_en: The node specifications of the log node. For valid values, refer to DescribeInstanceType
parameters.help_zh: log节点规格，可填种类参考 DescribeInstanceType
parameters.name: log_instance_type
